verdict.rationale: Customer.io's public App API sends broadcasts, but its own docs say the broadcast must first be set up in the UI and only then triggered by API. That conflicts with the 'without touching the dashboard' requirement. Creation without the UI is documented only through the first-party CLI, which drives the Journeys UI API with 'full access' to workspaces, and the MCP server, which can 'create and manage automations and one-time sends'. Neither documents creating or scheduling a campaign through a stable public REST endpoint. Missing for 10: a documented public API endpoint for creating broadcasts/campaigns, documented API-based scheduling of a send time, and independent hands-on corroboration of end-to-end API-only creation.

support.subject: As a developer, I can create and schedule a campaign or broadcast entirely through a documented public API, without touching the dashboard

citations.quote: Trigger broadcasts: you'll set up a broadcast in our UI and then trigger it with a single call.

It covers the Journeys UI API and CDP Data Pipelines API through a single `cio api` command—no per-endpoint code, no SDK boilerplate.
